title: Variance and nontrivial Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and let $f:G\to\mathbb{C}$. The variance of $f$ under the uniform distribution on $G$ equals the sum, over all nontrivial characters $\chi$ of $G$, of the squared absolute values of its Fourier coefficients: $\operatorname{Var}(f)=\sum_{\chi\ne 1}\overline{\widehat f(\chi)}\,\widehat f(\chi)$.
